notes.title: 【Shinobi non Grata #10】Introduction of Enemy in the game1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621042/41dd1b5eacdaff4d2d92621b872f36ec3453490b.png[/img]
Shinobi alert! Use your 7 shinobi weapons to survive the bloodshed during the Bakumatsu-era!

we will present you with information about the enemy characters and items in the upcoming game [b]"Shinobi non Grata" [/b]scheduled for release on May 25, 2023.

In this[b] #10[/b] update, following the previous content, we will continue to introduce information about [b]the enemy[/b]  in the game.

[h3][b]◽️Enemy[/b] [/h3]
[h3][b]Shinobi non grata Character introduction "Hito-Dama"[/b][/h3]
The grudge of a person who has failed to attain Buddhahood. It appears from off-screen and slowly approaches its prey, sucking its lifeblood. In addition to its relentless pursuit of its prey, it is also quite durable.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/d56e3c291ae9ca1accb2bfb85afe9d87e6b228a3.png[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/c432855cc1ac9a54cc325884e073c05749648459.png[/img]


[h3][b]Shinobi non grata Character introduction“Zombie”[/b][/h3]
A corpse revived by the anti-soul technique of Mukuro-Tenzen, a jounin of the Oboro clan. They move slowly, but they are sensitive to the scent of the living and attack them.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/58ca95d4824427ee1317cc50e61e1e1b78c9c0a0.png[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/b268b3c7f4d22e6c237bf2873489854653eaa774.png[/img]


[h3][b]Shinobi non grata Character introduction“Muscular”[/b][/h3]
Muscular is a low-ranking ninja of the Oboro clan. Its huge physique blocks the way to the target. Their weapons have a wide attack range, so be sure to guide them well and strike them down.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/b4083ce81eb11a7a0f7f759c3e3188b629cbae7b.png[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/c62e31aa19f6bb42ce68ad465f7802493328cc5f.png[/img]


[h3][b]Shinobi non grata Character introduction“Musha”[/b][/h3]
A chunin of the Oboro clan. He is a warrior who wears armor all over his body. He has an all-around attack pattern, and his "Engetsu Zari" has no blind spots and is quick to react. Never challenge him in close combat.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/8e78e029d7633b251ea1cb19768a5d0334ae8d94.png[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/6bdbce527e31410463c95b6f7eeea3f296f2e8b7.png[/img]


[h3][b]Shinobi non grata Character introduction“Monk”[/b][/h3]
He repeatedly moves at instantaneous speeds to distract opponents, and fires a "Nenbutsu (Buddhist prayer) bullet" that cannot be counteracted by swords or sickles. It is important to recognize the signs and deal with it quickly.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/32c43d7923748e0384aaeed7701be4b20f484f33.png[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/80bda41c044314d883e2189835bb4ad979812a01.png[/img]


[h3][b]Shinobi non grata Character introduction“Ronin”[/b][/h3]
Ronin are hunters who are hired by the Oboro clan for money. However, they are skilled and are the strongest small fry character, bouncing back from all subweapons and slashing at them with their special iai when they get in close!
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/1710b3c1bc4a97f295df0488e947365bf8564156.png[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/0855703dd13c9f9eac3852f1b623001fcf903d2e.png[/img]


[h3][b]Shinobi non grata Character introduction“Seal”[/b][/h3]
This is a tool installed in the Oboro clan that serves as the starting point of the warding system. It uses an enormous amount of "soul" energy to form a ward, blocking the way forward. Unless the ward is broken, it is impossible to proceed.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/7a9629d3ff6d3dc1d5adca1d667755735280cb2f.png[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/b6ab5f8c74425e19e19893dad86a2042d3663e94.png[/img]

It is the year 2048. Tokyo Police Department’s notorious 9th Mobile Unit, “The Scramble Vice” is ready to fight high-tech robot crime!

Clad in an armed exoskeleton suit, police officer Sakuragi Kei of the 9th unit stands to fight robot crimes within Neo Tokyo!

Her suit “ASURA” can equip various firearms and melee weapons. It is also installed with a “Homing Missile” function that follows targets wherever they go, and a “Roller Boost” function that can dodge even the heaviest rain of enemy projectiles.

Are you ready to scramble up Tokyo?

notes.title: 【Shinobi non Grata #9】Introducing Enemy & Items in the Game!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/152a8673ad1b2ab48040b5f48bffe91c4cda1707.jpg[/img]
Shinobi alert! Use your 7 shinobi weapons to survive the bloodshed during the Bakumatsu-era!

we will present you with information about the enemy characters and items in the upcoming game [b]"Shinobi non Grata" [/b]scheduled for release on May 25, 2023.

In this [b]#9[/b] update, let's start by introducing the details about the [b]enemy[/b] and game [b]items[/b].

[h3][b]◽️Enemy 
Shinobi non grata Enemy "Ge-Nin”[/b][/h3]
A low-ranking fighter of the Oboro clan. They are no match for kaina, but they are prepared to stab each other in the back, so be on your guard.
The shurikens and bombs they throw can be canceled out by swords.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/17cdd411c56f3631c3db6255cf4c34898bf85dcb.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/6a58eab0ec3569bf620ab9cef32852de50e4c047.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/3122d9004c977760c9785ede50652a7df1ad045d.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/593400d75180a56d9463d70007e762469951c26a.png[/img]


[h3][b]Sinobi non grata Enemy "Yari-Nin"[/b][/h3]
A ninja who rushes forward while holding a spear. Because of its long reach, even if you counter with a sword, you will be damaged first. He wears armor, so his durability is also high.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/31f9f3707158bf2254b5a75b1e0091cf54965c6c.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/a00a06fa6fac9b2939d406342a426ebc65496a77.png[/img]


[h3][b]Shinobi non grata Enemy "Nin-Ken"[/b][/h3]
A dog trained for combat. When it catches sight of your aircraft, it will lunge or jump at you. With his speed of movement and excellent sense of smell, he will not let his prey escape once he has targeted it.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/01e655d7ab3372e80a510fa5ec8edd70af398d9d.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/78e05f5ce3d61d111a00142adb3e096872678f70.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]Shinobi non grata Enemy "Hawk”[/b][/h3]
A highly trained hawk. It is a troublesome opponent that persistently pursues your aircraft, and when it sees an opening, it suddenly swoops down and attacks. Moreover, it "avoids" our attacks.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/dcf6c0fdd3ecd80a430ea9a6b6b9d3afd674c506.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/0dbce058e6a1ddcbd81ffe58e7e021b58c08650a.png[/img]


[h3][b]◽️Items
Shinobi non grata item "scroll"[/b][/h3]
Occasionally, scrolls that allow the use of ninja techniques for a certain period of time will appear from wooden crates in the game.
[b]Red [/b]is "Flash Jutsu"....deals damage to enemies on the screen. 
[b]Blue [/b]is "jutsu of alter ego"... It follows an alter ego for a certain period of time. 
[b]Green[/b] is "Infinite Jutsu"...Your "soul" will not decrease for a certain period of time.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/b8335ecdb6a4a7956fa5004b7ee49023b0e056f0.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/23e6d11c6d9f4b49857ffd4b5ad7fd07642665ed.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/5c920119f430b0c0802d3fae3152671934cbfe1c.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41621042/ac7988bcfdd1af97bcf95db7122115b6301798fc.png[/img]


===========================
Here is the content for #9. Previously, we announced the release date of the game in "FLYHIGH EXPRESS 2023.04." The release day, May 25th, is getting closer and closer! We hope everyone continues to follow our updates!

As we countdown to the release day, we will continue to unveil more game setting information about the game. Please keep an eye on our updates and don't forget to add the game to your wishlist to stay updated on all the news related to the game. 
Your support means a lot to the developers! 
Thank you  so far!

[h3][b]The game will be released on May 25th. 
Stay tuned and look forward to it![/b][/h3]

notes.title: 【Shinobi non Grata #7】Introducing the Game's Protagonists！
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621042/41dd1b5eacdaff4d2d92621b872f36ec3453490b.png[/img]

Shinobi alert! Use your 7 shinobi weapons to survive the bloodshed during the Bakumatsu-era!

We have some exciting information about 「[b]Shinobi non Grata[/b]」! 

In this issue of Shinobi non Grata #7, we are excited to introduce [b]the game's protagonists[/b]！



[h3]Kaina[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621042/af204c09fa3bc581aab33995d3a5bf016e39a37d.png[/img]

Descendant of a demon-slaying ninja clan who has been raging war against demons since ancient times. Kaina (腕 meaning "arms" or "skills" in Japanese) was given their name due to his skillful use of arms, the 7 shinobi weapons. Kaina was seriously injured during an incident and suffers from amnesia.


 

[h3]Tsumuji[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621042/582844a77a81bc621592a07ffd25619613b590c9.png[/img]

A kunoichi from the same village as Kaina, their childhood friend.
Tsumuji stays one step ahead with her mission to sneak into the "Oboro Clan" 's hideout and steal their secrets. 
 

[h3]Agito[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621042/0e658b535c107ca7f70240ab3f02a78d8957592d.png[/img]

A demon sealed shinobi and Kaina's senior. For two years, their whereabouts have been unknown up until the "Oboro Clan" 's secret operations in the dark have been brought to light. 

～～

And, not long after we prepared this announcement, this fan art of Tsumuji was drawn！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621042/e585ab89f4ea8653c4719438d1514636722d9610.jpg[/img]

Veil ベエル(@veil8801) drew the fan art！

Hmm, this is cute！ Very chivalrous！
Looking forward to seeing more of Tsumuji in the game！

notes.title: 【Shinobi non Grata #4】New Main Visual Unveiled!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621042/163b8b809e13d0bd68f04c8f17c0fa4851cdabda.png[/img]

Shinobi alert! Use your 7 shinobi weapons to survive the bloodshed during the Bakumatsu-era!

We have some exciting information about 「[b]Shinobi non Grata[/b]」, which is scheduled to be released in 2022! 

In this issue of 【Shinobi non Grata #4】, we unveil the new main visual!

[h3]Here is the new main visual! [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621042/a73b9108b25682f7839427b099b52e6cf518e137.jpg[/img]

This main visual has a dynamic composition, right!?
Let's see what Shinobi non Grata creator picopico has to say about it.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621042/2e6bd6ef92f1a928701754be149c48071269162f.png[/img]
[b]KOU[/b]

This is a really cool main visual, isn't it?! Can you share with us what the point you are trying to express with this main visual was?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621042/370e78fce9012b41b4d269de48b2caa76bdb64fc.png[/img]
[b]picopico[/b]

I like [b]American comic books[/b],  and I wanted a visual created that perfectly [b]contrasts that with the in-game advertising[/b]. So I requested that the illustrator creates an image that resembles the tone and composition in a [b]cover of American comics[/b]. I'm not sure, but I think it has very symbolic good vibes. Picture-wise, there was some difficulty figuring out how to display the 7 shinobi weapons that the protagonist equips...Just in case, the design is set up to have the complete set of weapons perfectly concealed. Also, I like 90s-era video games, so I think other people will understand that and grin when they install it to play. In this situation, there is a battle scene with the stage 1 boss 「Ghost of a Dead Warrior」. It's an arcade-like idea that I had to create the stage 1 boss as a giant humanoid enemy. It has an 8bit style, but there will be many more flashy enemies in stage 2, so please look forward to them.




～～～～～

This now concludes【Shinobi non Grata #4】. What did you think about it?

That’s the end of this article!
